title: Medieval Castle
alt: Massive medieval castle with detailed interiors
description: A large-scale medieval castle project featuring intricate interior designs, custom terrain work, and authentic architectural details. Includes multiple towers, a grand hall, living quarters, and defensive structures.

title: Boss AI System
alt: Advanced boss behavior system for Minecraft Bedrock
description: Complex artificial intelligence system for boss mobs featuring multiple attack patterns, phase transitions, environmental interactions, and dynamic difficulty scaling. Includes custom animations and particle effects.

title: Particle Effects Library
description: Extensive library of custom particle effects including magic spells, environmental effects, combat visuals, and atmospheric elements. Optimized for performance and compatibility across different devices.

title: Skyblock World Generator
description: Advanced world generation system that creates unique skyblock islands with custom biomes, structures, and resources. Includes configurable difficulty settings and progression mechanics.
